reviews.comment:
Martes 12 de mayo a las 11.00 am vine a cargar y los 3playeros qué había en la playa de Brown, charlando entre ellos y viendo cosas en el celular. Lo cual hizo que estuviera 5minutos esperando que me atiendan. Ando en moto pero no me pregunto si era socio. Lindo para que les caiga el incógnito

(Translated by Google)
On Tuesday, May 12th at 11:00 AM, I came to recharge my phone, and the three people at Brown Beach were chatting amongst themselves and looking at their phones. This meant I had to wait five minutes to be served. I ride a motorcycle, but they didn't ask if I was a member. Nice to catch them in the act of being anonymous.
